students.name: Name
students.consent_data: The guardian signed the consent to keep and use the data
students.consent_sms: The guardian agrees to SMS notifications
students.delete_hint: The student is removed from every active {{unit}} and their login and files are deleted. Fee, attendance and result records stay.

fees.frequency_locked: Money was collected under this head, so how often can no longer change.
fees.amount_hint: A new amount applies to unpaid dues only; earlier receipts stay as they are.

state.new: Not saved yet — everyone is marked 'present' below

consent.title: Privacy & consent
consent.intro: Please read how the institution will use the data of your child ({{names}}) and give your consent. You can change it later in settings.

data_processing.title: Keeping and using the data
data_processing.body: The institution keeps your child's data for admission, attendance, results and fees. The portal cannot be used without this.

sms.title: SMS notifications
sms.body: Absence, notice and reminder SMS. Payment receipts and password codes are always sent.

photo.title: Publishing photos
photo.body: Use of your child's photo at events or on the website (other than the ID card).

central.tagline: Students, attendance, fees and results in one place for schools, colleges, coaching centres and private batches.
central.signup_soon: Sign-up for new institutions opens soon. Please contact the platform for now.

plan.suspended: The institution's subscription is suspended — read only. Please contact the platform.

upload.choose: Choose a file or drop it here
upload.too_big: The file is larger than {{max}} MB

teachers.title: Teachers
teachers.name: Name
teachers.login_hint: The teacher sets a password with "Forgot password" using this mobile or email.

imports.title: Import data
imports.intro: Bring students from an old register or another program: upload, match the columns, check, then run. A run can be undone for 7 days.
imports.map_hint: For each field, pick the column of your file. Fields with * are required.
imports.running: Importing… this page updates by itself.
imports.rollback_confirm: Undo the import? The students it created are removed (except those with records since).

exams.title: Exams & results
exams.name: Exam name
exams.subjects_hint: Every subject of the {{unit}} is added; you can change full marks, schedule and parts later.
exams.publish_hint: Parents will see it; bulk entry and the marks scale close.
exams.locked_hint: The result is published - marks can no longer change here.

sms.title: SMS
sms.parts_hint: Each SMS part costs {{rate}}: English 150 characters per part, Bengali 70 (67 when split). Your own API is not charged.

settings.title: SMS settings

routes.universal: the universal API (charged from the SMS wallet)

settings.universal_hint: The platform's API and sender ({{sender}}); each SMS part costs {{rate}} from the SMS wallet.
settings.own_hint: Your own BulkSMSBD API key and masking sender. Nothing is taken from the wallet. If it fails and the universal sender is on, the SMS is sent once through the universal API (charged).
settings.key_none: No key saved yet. The key is kept encrypted and never shown again.
settings.remove_confirm: Remove your own API key and sender? The own sender is switched off.

recharge.title: Recharge the SMS wallet
recharge.hint: Pay with bKash; the money is added to your SMS wallet as soon as bKash confirms (10 - 50,000 taka).
recharge.success: Payment received - the SMS wallet is recharged.
recharge.failed: The payment did not go through; nothing was added.

hints.students: Active students of the chosen {{unit}}, by roll.
hints.attendance: Daily attendance of one {{unit}} for the month (P/A/L/V, H = holiday) and the rate.
hints.dues: Every unpaid due per student - the same numbers as the counter.
hints.fees: Every receipt line of the month and the total.

super.name: Name
super.slug_hint: Small letters, digits and -; it becomes <slug>.your-domain
super.password_hint: At least 8 characters; they must change it on first login
super.suspend_hint: Users of this institution can no longer work until it is activated again.
super.modules_hint: An override wins over the type's default; the institution's menu changes at once.
super.universal_hint: Every institution that uses the universal sender pays from its SMS wallet at this rate. Keep the BulkSMSBD account itself recharged.
super.rate_hint: One part = 150 English or 70 Bengali characters (67 when split)
super.key_none: No key yet - SMS are only written to the log.

bkash.title: bKash merchant (SMS-wallet recharge)
bkash.hint: The platform's own bKash tokenized-checkout account. Institutions recharge their SMS wallet through it. Secrets are kept encrypted and never shown again; an empty field keeps the saved value.
bkash.base_url_hint: Leave empty to use bKash's own address (sandbox or live, by the switch above), or paste the one from your merchant documents.
bkash.callback_base_hint: bKash sends the payer back to this https address. Empty = APP_URL. bKash refuses a local address (lvh.me): use your own domain or a tunnel; its host must be in CENTRAL_DOMAINS in .env.
bkash.test_failed: bKash refused - check the address and the credentials.

purge.title: Remove for good
purge.hint: For an institution suspended or expired for more than 30 days: every row, file and login of it is deleted. Backups age out in 30 days. This cannot be undone.
purge.handed_over: I confirm in writing that the institution was given its data (export) before removal.

privacy.anonymize_hint: After an erasure request: name, phones, address, photo and every file of this student are removed, the login and the parent link are closed. Attendance, results and fee receipts stay without a name. This cannot be undone.
privacy.anonymized: The student's personal data was removed.
privacy.failed: That did not work - please try again.

qb.curriculum_hint: One curriculum for every institution - class → subject → chapter → topic. Questions, concepts and resources hang on this tree; a part in use cannot be deleted, only switched off.
qb.pick_subject: Pick a subject to see its chapters
qb.pick_chapter: Pick a chapter to see its topics
qb.platform_class_hint: Students see this class's content first in the question bank
qb.phone_hint: The login code goes to this number
qb.writer_off_hint: Every session ends at once; their questions stay.
qb.question: Question
qb.author: Writer
qb.subject: Subject
qb.reason_hint: Returning needs a reason - the writer sees it
qb.math_hint: Write the formula; Insert puts it into the text as $...$
qb.math_inline_hint: Write maths as $...$, or use the Maths button
qb.label: Label
qb.add_picture: Add a picture (PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF, up to 2 MB)
qb.word_box_hint: The words to choose from, separated by commas
qb.gap_answers_hint: Several accepted answers separated by commas
qb.order_hint: Write the pieces in the right order - students see them shuffled
qb.no_resources: No slides, books or PDFs here yet.
qb.title: Title
qb.place_hint: It is filed under the deepest one you pick: the topic, else the chapter, else the subject.
qb.page_count_hint: A whole number from 1. Filled in from the PDF when it can be read.
qb.preview_pages_hint: Pictures of the first pages (up to 10) - every institution sees these before buying.
qb.pick_topic: Pick a topic to see its concepts.
qb.locked_concepts: Your institution has not bought this concept yet - only its title shows.
qb.locked_resources: Your institution has not bought this yet - the preview pages show; the file opens once bought.

qbp.title: Question bank: prices and rules
qbp.prices_hint: A price is never edited: a new price applies from its time on; earlier purchases keep their price.
qbp.no_prices: No price set yet - nothing can be bought.
qbp.rules_hint: Free rules win first; otherwise the most specific rule (item > topic > chapter > subject > class > type > all), then priority, then the newest. A rule is switched off, never deleted.
qbp.from_hint: Empty = now. Never in the past.
qbp.target_ref_hint: An item as question:12 / concept:3 / resource:5, a resource kind as pdf, otherwise the number (topic, chapter, subject, class, type).
qbp.rule_off_hint: It stays in the list for the record; prices go back to what the other rules give.

methods.first_n_pages_free: First N pages free to read

qbb.confirm_title: Buy for ৳{{price}} from the institution wallet?
qbb.confirm_hint: Wallet balance: ৳{{balance}}. Every teacher of the institution can use it afterwards.

qbpp.title: Title
qbpp.author: Made by
qbpp.unbought_title: {{n}} questions are not bought yet - buy them for ৳{{total}}?
qbpp.unbought_hint: From the institution wallet; every teacher can use them afterwards. Then the paper is saved.

payment.success: Payment received - it is open now.
payment.failed: The payment did not go through; nothing was charged for it here.

qbz.title: Quizzes
qbz.buy_hint: ৳{{price}} - paid with bKash; {{days}} days from the purchase.
qbz.login_to_save: To keep your result, log in on your institution's page and take the quiz there.
qbz.off_confirm: Switch it off? Nothing is deleted; past results stay.
qbz.package_hint: A package's price is the student "quiz package" price on the prices and rules page.
qbz.find_hint: Only published MCQ, true/false, gap and matching questions can be used.

qbe.title: Earnings and withdrawals
qbe.share_hint: You get {{percent}}% of every sale. Minimum withdrawal: ৳{{min}}.
qbe.account_hint: A bKash number, or bank, branch and account number. Only you and the Super Admin see it.
qbe.requested: Request sent - the amount is held.
qbe.share_percent_hint: Applies from the next sale; past earnings do not change.
qbe.pay_hint: Send ৳{{amount}} to {{writer}} by bank / bKash and enter the transaction id. Then the amount leaves the writer's balance.
qbe.reject_hint: The request of {{writer}} for ৳{{amount}} is rejected; the held amount is released.

staff.accounts_hint: A staff account gets work only through department duties; it has no access of its own.
staff.portal_hint: Choose a department to work in it. You see only the work your duties allow.
